description: Charter §8 standardized assessment core — versioned anchor probes. Wording is FROZEN for this version: probes are appended verbatim by the server (never generated, never templated), so every candidate receives byte-identical anchor wording regardless of candidate name, avatar choice, scenario or conversational style. Changing any probe requires a new version file (prompt law).

communication.text: Before we go further — in two or three sentences, how would you sum up where things stand right now, so everyone in the room is on the same page?

criticalThinking.text: One more thing — what is the single most important piece of information we still don't have here, and how would having it change what you do?

collaboration.text: Setting your own view aside for a moment — what do you think the person who most disagrees with you here actually needs, and how would you respond to that?

problemSolving.text: If you had to commit to one concrete first step right now, what would it be — and what would you deliberately leave for later?

aiDigitalFluency.text: Suppose you had an AI assistant available to you right now for this situation. What would you ask it to do, and what would you personally double-check before acting on what it gives you?
